creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The `muster-seam` `respawn` binary fails intermittently on a loaded machine, and it is
whichever of its three tests loses that particular run:

- `a_bridge_that_died_on_a_pane_the_daemon_still_holds_is_replaced`
  (`herdr-harness/src/until.rs:81`, "timed out after 20s waiting for the core to
  publish the pane on its first replacement")
- `a_surface_muster_tore_down_gets_no_replacement` (`respawn.rs:55`, `respawn.rs:243`)
- `a_bridge_that_keeps_dying_is_given_up_on` (`respawn.rs:92`)

CI hit the first one on run 33999501888. Re-running the same commit passed, and the
last fifteen gate runs carry four failures on four different tests - the other three
being exactly the ones `a_2KCtOvgbo` fixed. This is a fourth member of that family.

## It predates the fix that exposed it

Measured while checking whether `a_2J1KZe2ws` caused it. 96 runs of the whole binary at
each of two commits, alternating in blocks of six under one continuous CPU load so drift
hit both sides equally:

|  | `3544fc5` (before) | `5b421e5` (after) |
|---|---|---|
| runs failing | 3 of 96 | 4 of 96 |
| the CI signature specifically | 2 | 0 |

Three against four is one occurrence apart and says nothing. The signature line answers
it: the exact CI failure happened twice at the earlier commit and never at the later one.

## How to reproduce

It does not appear on a quiet machine - 20 serial runs, 32 runs at 6-way concurrency and
24 runs of the whole binary all passed with nothing else happening. With 16-20 CPU
burners alongside it shows up within about 30 runs.

Running the one failing test with `--exact` never reproduces it. The failure needs the
whole binary, which is what says it is cross-test rather than a broken replacement path.

## A place to look, unverified

`bridge_ended` calls `resnapshot` before `replace_bridge`, and `replace_bridge` opens
with `if !session.holds(pane) { respawns.forget(pane); return; }`. `resnapshot` rebuilds
the whole mirror from a fresh fetch. If the pane is absent from the mirror at the instant
`holds` is asked, the replacement is dropped and nothing retries - which matches the
observed shape exactly, a view stuck at `bridge_restarts: 0` for the whole 20 seconds
rather than arriving late or arriving wrong.

Nobody has confirmed the mirror is ever actually empty there. Treat it as where to start,
not as the diagnosis.

## Reproducing the A/B itself

Comparing two commits needs both binaries runnable at once. Building the base into a
second `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` works, but the test binary loads `@rpath/libghostty-vt.dylib`
by a path relative to the target dir, so it aborts on exec until `deps/ghostty` is
symlinked beside the scratch target dir. Copying the binary elsewhere fails the same way.
The abort is dyld, not a signature.
title: 🎲 All three respawn tests are flaky under load, one per run
